description: One file swaps ASR or LLM independently. It never edits lifemate/agent.py: loader.py maps each section onto the real lifemate constructors and reports anything unexpressible as a GAP instead of silently dropping it. This JSON Schema is documentation; loader.py enforces the same rules in stdlib Python (jsonschema is optional in the repo) and is the authority on CPU.

agent_unchanged.description: Assertion, not a setting: swapping checkpoints must never require an agent.py change. If a swap seems to need one, that is a GAP to report, not an edit to make here.

beam_size.description: Only 1 is expressible, for the same reason.

checkpoint.description: Local checkpoint directory (preferred for a fine-tune) or HF id. For faster-whisper this must be a CTranslate2-converted directory; a transformers-format directory will fail at load (see README GAP A1).

greedy.description: Only true is expressible: transcribe() hardcodes beam_size=1.

hotwords.description: Any non-empty value is a GAP: no constructor/transcribe parameter exists.

initial_prompt.description: Any non-empty value is a GAP, same reason.

kind.description: transformers is declarable but UNBUILDABLE today: lifemate/asr.py has no transformers ASR class (GAP, see loader.resolve_asr_kwargs).

language.description: Only 'vi' is expressible: FasterWhisperASR.transcribe() hardcodes language='vi'.

revision.description: Any non-null value is a GAP: FasterWhisperASR has no revision parameter. Use a local directory to pin exactly.

chat_template_source.description: If set and != checkpoint, GAP: both generators use the checkpoint's own chat template.

checkpoint.description: Local checkpoint directory (preferred for a fine-tune) or HF id.

device.description: Used by TransformersGenerator only; ignored (warning) for vllm.

load_kind.description: full = weights as stored; merged = a fine-tune already merged into full weights (loads like full); adapter = LoRA/PEFT adapter directory, UNBUILDABLE today (GAP: no constructor takes base_model + adapter_path).

max_context_tokens.description: Must be <= 16384. Enforced by loader validation, NOT by either generator (neither takes it; see loader warning).

max_tokens.description: Used by VLLMGenerator; TransformersGenerator hardcodes 512, so any other value is a GAP for kind=transformers.

revision.description: HF revision. For a local directory this is informational; the directory itself is the pin.

seed.description: Used by VLLMGenerator; ignored (with a warning) by TransformersGenerator, which has no seed parameter.

stop.description: Any non-empty list is a GAP: stopping is the template stop token plus the {"stop": true} rule in parse_model_output.

temperature.description: Only 0.0 is expressible: vLLM hardcodes 0.0, transformers hardcodes do_sample=False (greedy).

tokenizer_source.description: If set and != checkpoint, GAP: both generators use AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(checkpoint).

name.description: Human label for this pair, e.g. baseline-asr + sft-llm-v1. Not an identity: identity is checkpoint + revision/hash in the manifest.

title: LifeMate checkpoint config v1 (single config, ASR + LLM, independent swap)
